brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
concept: a space-filling stream of information I will never read, endlessly expanding beyond my capacity to comprehend it. @buildthis.bisks.net you know what to do

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@norvid-studies.bsky.social: concept: it's like a for you feed but it's only the papers people I follow are reading or linking and it's like live queued to their zotero or something. does this exist and/or did it already fail
  [quoting @yhjet.bsky.social: oh neat this is apparently being studied 
arxiv.org/abs/2510.07858 (link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07858)]
note: built unread: a canvas that splits into smaller tiles, one per live bluesky post, until there's no room left — then new posts start burying old ones instead. hover a tile to read exactly one.
